name: Sticky Maple-Dijon Wings & Apple Caesar Salad with Crispy Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tbsp cornstarch
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the maple-Dijon sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup pure maple syrup
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 head romaine lettuce
2 Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillets. Place both in another clean medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic and anchovy.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl along with mayo, oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
57 g Parmesan cheese
2 tbsp mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are almost done, separate lettuce into leaves, tearing larger leaves into pieces as needed. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl, gently toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven. Add to the bowl with the maple-Dijon sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Top salad with crispy breadcrumbs and enjoy!
